reason: Conversation 1 correctly explained E:15 as the anti-flood float, immediately isolated both power and water, honestly stated that with foam ruled out there is a real internal leak that cannot be localised without pulling the unit, and gave realistic escalation (engineer, Bosch fixed-price repair, insurance) without committing to a specific part. Its weaknesses are that it leaned on DIY draining of the tray and running a test wash to localise the leak, which edges against the 'don't keep drying/running' boundary. Conversation 2 reached the right engineer conclusion but never advised turning off the water, wasted turns asking for checks the homeowner had already said were impossible (rear hoses, removing the plinth), and ended with a thin, repetitive close rather than useful next-step guidance.
